Your listing ID is —. Keep it, it is what your website badge uses. Digitalx has been notified and will review your listing within one to two business days.

Verification documents

      

      
How your documents are handled. They go to a private store that is not publicly readable, are opened only by a reviewer through a short-lived link, and are deleted within 90 days of the check being recorded. Your profile shows only that a check passed and when, never the document.
